# Kartikey Pathak — robotics engineer

> B.Tech Electrical Engineering (Minor: Robotics), VJTI Mumbai, 2023–2027.
> Tinkerer-engineer who builds across robotics: drones, quadrupeds, robot
> arms, boats, IoT products — with deep work in localization (UWB, SLAM/NAV2),
> ROS2/Gazebo simulation, and ESP32/ESP-IDF embedded systems.

Key facts:
- Electronics and hardware engineer, Eyecandy Robotics (Apr–Aug 2026,
  Bangalore): production PCBs for a small legged consumer robot — compute
  carrier, motor driver with audio codec, and a power board delivering 17 motors
  off one battery (li-ion charging, BMS, buck converters); cross-domain hardware
  debugging across the robot fleet.
- Final year project: coreless axial-flux BLDC motor whose stator is the PCB
  itself — 100 mm two-layer board, 6 wedge coils over 8 poles, dual 3D-printed
  rotor with 16 N42 magnets across a 0.5 mm air gap. FEMM magnetostatic models
  gave Kt 40.9 mN·m/A and Kv 496 rpm/V with exactly zero cogging, and identified
  a 3.3x torque loss caused by the plastic rotor before fabrication.
- Research intern, Krishna Defence & Allied Industries (May–Jul 2025, at IIT
  Gandhinagar): custom DS-TWR UWB ranging firmware — 315 m range (stock limit
  was 45 m), ±2 cm short-range accuracy, 0.4% error over 10,000 m², validated
  with a surveyor's total station.
- Robotics intern, NishCorp Technologies (May–Nov 2025): Gazebo simulation +
  half-scale prototype of a stair-climbing wheelchair; supported ₹13 lakh in
  grants.
- e-Yantra (IIT Bombay) national semifinalist — autonomous warehouse drone.
- SRA (Society of Robotics and Automation, VJTI): workshops and mentoring;
  Wall-E self-balancing kit program has taught 200+ students.
